payload.reason: The evidence provides specific datasets used in the study, including the NRC Hashtag Emotion Lexicon and various sentiment lexicons derived from Twitter data.

claims.text: The dataset used includes the NRC Hashtag Emotion Lexicon, which contains emotion word associations computed on an emotion-labeled Twitter corpus.
The study also utilized sentiment word associations from the NRC Hashtag Sentiment Lexicon and Sentiment140 Lexicon, both derived from Twitter data.
GloVe embeddings trained on 2 billion tweets were integrated into the dataset for word vector representations.
